{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Fruit Company''' employed poverty-stricken workers during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Owned and run by the Empire, it exported various exotic fruits throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The IFC had an outpost on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] that worked with [[Imperial Exports]] to transfer the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] exotic fruits off world.
